article_blocks.text: Strain Type: Indica-dominant Hybrid
Genetics: White Widow × Afghani
Breeder: Green House Seeds
THC Content: 20–25%
CBD Content: Low (under 1%)
Terpene Profile: Myrcene , Caryophyllene , Pinene
Primary Flavors: Earthy pine, woody spice, subtle sweetness
Flowering Time (Indoor): 8–9 weeks
Outdoor Harvest Time: Late September to early October
Indoor Yield: 18–22 oz/m²
Outdoor Yield: 20+ oz per plant
Grow Difficulty: Easy to Moderate

Some cannabis strains carry reputations built on sheer physical impact. White Rhino is one of those cultivars. Developed by Green House Seeds, the hybrid quickly gained recognition for producing dense, resinous buds and a powerful body-focused high that lives up to its imposing name. The strain represents a classic example of how indica genetics can be combined with modern hybrid breeding to produce a marijuana variety designed primarily for deep relaxation.

Rather than offering the bright cerebral stimulation found in many sativa-dominant strains , this cultivar emphasizes calm and physical ease. Aromas of earthy pine and hash-like sweetness hint at its Afghan lineage, while the high gradually spreads through the body with a steady and grounding presence. For cannabis enthusiasts seeking strong evening weed, the hybrid has long been considered a dependable choice.
Genetics and Lineage

White Rhino was developed by Green House Seeds, a renowned Dutch breeding company responsible for several influential cannabis strains. The hybrid combines White Widow with an Afghan indica lineage, bringing together two genetic traditions known for potency and resin production.

White Widow contributes a large portion of the plant’s resin-rich character. Originally bred in the Netherlands during the 1990s, White Widow quickly became famous for its thick coating of trichomes and balanced hybrid marijuana effects. In this cross, the strain provides strong cannabinoid production along with subtle sweetness in the terpene profile.

The Afghan parent introduces the heavy body relaxation that defines the hybrid’s personality. Cannabis plants originating from Afghanistan are historically associated with dense buds, earthy aromas, and deeply calming physical effects. These traits complement the potency inherited from White Widow, producing a cultivar capable of delivering both strong flavor and pronounced relaxation.
Effects and Experience

The experience with White Rhino typically begins with a mild cerebral lift. Shortly after inhalation, many individuals notice a gentle sense of euphoria accompanied by mental calm. The early stage of the high feels steady and controlled rather than stimulating.

As the effects progress, physical relaxation becomes increasingly prominent. Muscles begin to loosen, and a warm heaviness spreads through the body. The sensation often starts in the shoulders or upper back before gradually moving downward. This steady build creates a comforting sense of calm rather than an abrupt sedative effect.

Eventually the body-focused qualities reach their peak. At this stage, the strain can produce strong relaxation that encourages rest or quiet activities. Because of its heavy physical presence, many cannabis consumers reserve this weed for evening use when the day’s responsibilities have already been completed.
Medical Benefits

White Rhino has attracted attention among patients seeking cannabis strains capable of delivering substantial physical relief. The strong body relaxation produced by the hybrid may help ease muscle tension that accumulates during demanding physical activity or long workdays. For individuals coping with persistent discomfort, the calming effects can offer meaningful support.

Sleep support is another area where the cultivar is frequently explored. As the high deepens, the tranquil physical sensation often encourages restfulness. People experiencing difficulty unwinding at night sometimes gravitate toward indica-dominant strains with similar profiles.

Stress reduction also contributes to its therapeutic appeal. The mild euphoria present during the early stage of the experience may help quiet racing thoughts and ease emotional tension. Patients incorporating medical cannabis into evening routines often look for strains capable of creating both mental calm and physical relaxation.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

The terpene profile of White Rhino reflects its Afghan heritage combined with the influence of White Widow. Opening a jar of cured buds typically reveals a deep earthy aroma reminiscent of traditional hashish. Pine and herbal spice often follow closely behind, giving the fragrance a warm and grounded character.

Breaking apart the flowers releases additional aromatic layers. Myrcene contributes the earthy base that dominates the scent, while caryophyllene introduces a subtle peppery spice. Pinene adds freshness through light evergreen notes that brighten the overall profile.

When smoked or vaporized, the flavor closely mirrors the aroma. The inhale usually delivers woody earth and pine resin, followed by a gentle sweetness. As the smoke leaves the palate, peppery spice becomes more pronounced. The aftertaste tends to linger, leaving a herbal warmth that complements the strain’s calming effects.
Growing Information

White Rhino typically displays growth patterns characteristic of indica-dominant cannabis plants. The plant usually develops a compact structure with sturdy branches capable of supporting heavy flowers. Because of this natural form, it adapts well to indoor growing environments.

Flowering generally completes within eight to nine weeks. During this stage, dense buds form along the branches and gradually become coated in thick trichomes inherited from the White Widow lineage. By the final weeks before harvest, the plant emits a pungent aroma of earth, pine, and spice.

For cultivators planning to grow marijuana , maintaining proper airflow and moderate humidity levels is important due to the density of the buds. Good ventilation helps prevent moisture buildup during late flowering. When grown under stable conditions with balanced nutrients and adequate lighting, the plant produces resin-heavy flowers that showcase strong potency and visual appeal.
FAQ
What strain is White Rhino? White Rhino is an indica-dominant hybrid bred by Green House Seeds using White Widow and Afghan indica genetics.
How strong is White Rhino cannabis? THC levels typically range between 20% and 25%, making it a potent marijuana strain.
What does White Rhino taste like? The flavor profile commonly includes earthy pine, hash-like sweetness, peppery spice, and subtle herbal notes.
Is White Rhino good for nighttime use? Yes. The strong body relaxation and calming high make the strain well suited for evening sessions.
How long does the White Rhino high last? The effects usually last two to three hours, beginning with mild euphoria before transitioning into deep physical relaxation.
Final Thoughts on White Rhino

White Rhino remains one of the more recognizable indica-dominant cannabis strains to emerge from the Dutch breeding scene. By combining the resin-rich potency of White Widow with the grounding influence of Afghan genetics, Green House Seeds produced a hybrid capable of delivering powerful relaxation and distinctive aroma.

One of the strain’s defining features is the progression of its effects. Rather than delivering an immediate knockout sensation, the high unfolds gradually, moving from gentle mental calm to full-body relaxation. This steady transition allows the cultivar to provide comfort while still maintaining clarity during the early stages. The terpene profile adds another dimension to its appeal. Earthy pine, herbal spice, and subtle sweetness create a fragrance that reflects the plant’s Afghan heritage while retaining hints of White Widow’s complexity.

Growers continue to appreciate the plant for its manageable structure and abundant resin production. Dense buds coated in trichomes make the cultivar visually impressive and suitable for various cannabis concentrates . Taken together, these characteristics explain why White Rhino has maintained its reputation for decades. Its combination of strong physical effects, rich flavor, and dependable genetics ensures that the strain remains a respected member of the broader marijuana landscape.
